info.title: k-otp API
info.description:
OTP issue, verify, status, dashboard history, wallet balance/ledger, and template API.

All operations are also exposed as oRPC procedures under `/v1/rpc/otp/*` (used by the official SDKs).

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. `pk_` public keys are for browsers and only work on
`POST /issue` and `POST /verify` with an exact-match `Origin`; `sk_` secret keys are server-side only.
See the `publicKey` / `secretKey` security schemes and each operation's `x-required-scopes`.

**Errors.** Non-2xx responses use the envelope `{ defined, code, status, message, data? }`.

**Rate limits.** `POST /issue` and `POST /verify` enforce the API key's rate-limit policy, a platform default for `pk_` keys and a platform ceiling.
An exceeded limit returns 429 `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds) and `data.retryAfterMs`.

**Request id.** Every response carries `X-Request-Id` (also exposed to allowed browser origins via CORS).
A request `X-Request-Id` matching `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$` is echoed; otherwise the API generates one.
Quote it when contacting support.

servers.description: Same origin as this document (local `bun run dev:api`, preview deployments)

tags.name: otp
tags.description: OTP issue, verify, status, dashboard history, wallet balance, ledger, and template APIs.

publicKey.description: Public key (`pk_` prefix, credential type `public_token`) for browser clients: `Authorization: Bearer pk_...`. Only `POST /issue` and `POST /verify` accept it. Every request must carry an `Origin` header that exactly matches one of the key's `allowedOrigins` (no wildcards); a missing or unlisted `Origin` is rejected with 403. A public key may only hold `otp:issue`, `otp:verify`; keys with any other scope (including `*`) are rejected at authentication.

secretKey.description: Secret key (`sk_` prefix, credential type `secret_token`) for server-side use only: `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`. Never embed it in browser or mobile clients. Each operation lists the scope it requires in `x-required-scopes`; `x-accepted-scopes` lists other scopes that also satisfy it (`*` grants every scope).

phoneNumber.description:
Recipient mobile number (at most 32 characters after trimming, with at least
one digit). Handled in canonical form: a Korean mobile number in any spelling
(`010-1234-5678`, `+82 10 1234 5678`) is `01012345678`; other numbers are
their digits only (`+1 415-555-0100` is `14155550100`). Stored only as a
hash and never returned by any endpoint.

purpose.description:
Caller-defined purpose label (1-64 characters after trimming). A new issue
for the same phone number and purpose replaces the previous active issue.

channel.description:
Delivery channel. When omitted, the OTP is delivered by KakaoTalk AlimTalk
with an automatic SMS fallback if AlimTalk delivery fails (included in the
AlimTalk price).

templateId.description:
Whitelisted template id from `GET /v1/templates`. The default template is
used when omitted.

templateVariables.description:
Values for the template's declared variables (see
`GET /v1/templates/{templateId}`). `code` is always supplied by the server
and must not be included.

from.description: Optional sender identity override (at most 64 characters after trimming).

messageType.description: Message type option; AlimTalk delivery and its SMS fallback ignore it.

cost.description:
Deprecated and ignored for billing. The credit amount reserved and debited
is always decided server-side from the delivery channel and cannot be
overridden by any key type. Still accepted for
compatibility: when sent it must be an integer from 1 to 100000, and it
remains part of the idempotency fingerprint.

metadata.description:
Free-form string key/value tags stored with the issue. Subject to a
server-side size budget and never returned by dashboard endpoints.

expiresInSec.description: OTP lifetime in seconds: an integer from 30 to 600. Defaults to 180.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum verification attempts: an integer from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

idempotencyKey.description:
Idempotency key; alternative to the `Idempotency-Key` header. One of the two
is required, and they must match when both are sent. 1-128 visible ASCII
characters without spaces after trimming. Reuse the same key when retrying.

webOtp.description:
Opt in to WebOTP (SMS code auto-fill on Android Chrome): the SMS fallback of
the AlimTalk message ends with the origin-bound line `@<host> #<code>`, so
`navigator.credentials.get({ otp })` on that origin can read it when the code
arrives by SMS. `true` binds the request `Origin` header (any key
type that sends one, typically a `pk_` browser call); `{ origin }` names it
explicitly (for `sk_` server calls; with a `pk_` key it must equal the request
`Origin`). The origin must be `https` without a path or port, and must be
listed in the key's `allowedOrigins`: a key without `allowedOrigins` cannot
use WebOTP (`http://localhost` and unlisted origins work only in local
development). `false` or omitted: no WebOTP line.

The KakaoTalk message itself never carries the line (KakaoTalk is not
readable by the OS), so `webOtp.status` is `fallback_only`: auto-fill works
when AlimTalk delivery fails and the SMS fallback is sent. WebOTP never
changes the price or the SMS type: the SMS fallback uses a compact template,
and when the compact body plus the line would exceed one SMS (90 bytes; ASCII
1, line break and other characters 2) the line is left out and the normal
text is sent. The response field `webOtp` reports the outcome. Part of the
idempotency fingerprint (as the bound host).

origin.description:
Origin of the page that reads the code, exactly as the browser serializes
it (scheme and host, no path or trailing slash).

issueId.description: Identifier of the issued OTP; pass it to `POST /v1/verify`.

expiresAt.description: When the OTP stops being verifiable (RFC 3339).

attemptsRemaining.description: Verification attempts left for this issue.

webOtp.description: Present only when the request set `webOtp`.

IssueOtpOutput.description: Result of `POST /v1/issue`. The OTP code itself is never returned.

status.description:
`fallback_only`: AlimTalk delivery (the default); the KakaoTalk message
cannot carry the line, only the SMS fallback sent if AlimTalk delivery fails
does, so auto-fill works only in that case. `applied`: the SMS carries
`@<host> #<code>`. `skipped`: sent without the line (see `reason`).

reason.description:
Why it was skipped. `host_too_long`: the compact SMS plus the WebOTP line
would exceed one SMS, so the normal text was sent instead (the message type
and price never change because of WebOTP). `channel_alimtalk`: AlimTalk
delivery while the SMS fallback is unavailable.

IssueWebOtpResult.description: WebOTP outcome of an issue that asked for it (`webOtp` on the request).

limit.description:
Rule that rejected the request: `perKey` (all requests of the key for this
operation), `perIp` (per client IP, issue only) or `perPhone` (per
recipient number, issue only).

policy.description:
`key`: the rate-limit policy configured on the API key. `platform`: a
platform limit, either the default for the key type (currently `pk_`
public keys) or the platform ceiling a key rule was capped at.

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until a retry can be admitted.

OtpRateLimitErrorData.description:
Error data of a 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS response from `POST /v1/issue` or
`POST /v1/verify`. The `Retry-After` response header carries the same wait
in whole seconds (rounded up).

code.description:
Why quota admission rejected the issue. `TRIAL_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: a
wallet that has never bought credits reached its daily send limit (free
trial); it lifts at `resetAt` or as soon as credits are purchased.

resetAt.description:
With `TRIAL_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: when the daily trial limit resets (the
next 00:00 Asia/Seoul, RFC 3339).

IssueOtpPaymentErrorData.description: Error data of a 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED response from `POST /v1/issue`.

code.description: The 6-digit numeric code the end user received.

verified.description: `true` only when the code matched an active, unexpired issue.

attemptsRemaining.description: Verification attempts left after this call.

verifiedAt.description: When the issue was verified (RFC 3339), if it has been.

VerifyOtpOutput.description:
Result of `POST /v1/verify`. A failed verification is still a 200 response
with `verified: false` and a `reasonCode`.

messageId.description: Identifier of the outbound message used for delivery tracking.

overallStatus.description:
`verificationStatus` unless it is `issued`; otherwise derived from
`deliveryStatus` for user-facing display.

providerOutcomeAmbiguous.description:
`true` when the provider outcome of the send is unknown (for example a
provider timeout). Such sends are never retried automatically.

GetIssueStatusOutput.description: Status of a single issue. The phone number is never included.

verificationStatus.description:
Filter by effective verification status. `issued` matches only unexpired
issues; `expired` also matches `issued` rows whose expiry has passed.

createdTo.description: Exclusive upper bound on `createdAt`; must be later than `createdFrom`.

ListOtpIssuesInput.description: Query for `GET /v1/issues`. All fields are optional.

DashboardPageLimit.description: Page size: 1-100 items. Defaults to 50 when omitted.

DashboardCursor.description:
Opaque keyset pagination cursor. Send back the `nextCursor` value unchanged;
a cursor is only valid for the endpoint that returned it.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

verificationStatus.description: Effective status: an `issued` row past its expiry is reported as `expired`.

deliveryStatus.description: Latest tracked delivery status; `unknown` when the tracker has no record or is unavailable.

debitedAmount.description: Credits debited for this issue so far.

expiresAt.description: Undefined only for legacy records that predate persisted expiry timestamps.

verifiedAt.description: Present once the issue was verified.

OtpDashboardIssue.description:
PII-free dashboard projection. Phone identifiers, OTP material, provider
payloads, idempotency values, and free-form metadata are intentionally absent.

OtpBillingStatus.description:
Billing lifecycle of an issue: credit is `reserved` at admission, then either
debited (`debit_pending` -> `debited`) or released (`release_pending` ->
`released`) once send processing finishes.

createdTo.description: Exclusive upper bound on `createdAt`; must be later than `createdFrom`.

ListOtpCreditLedgerInput.description: Query for `GET /v1/credit-ledger`. All fields are optional.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

issueId.description: Related issue for `debit`/`refund` entries; absent for `credit` top-ups and `clawback`.

appId.description:
Attribution app. Always the calling app for `debit`/`refund`; present on
organization-wallet `credit`/`clawback`/`promo_credit` entries only when
the purchase or grant was attributed to an app.

amountDelta.description:
Signed wallet delta: debit, clawback, promo_expire and promo_revoke are
negative; credit, refund and promo_credit are positive.

balanceAfter.description:
Wallet balance after the entry (the organization wallet when shared). May
be negative when the quota policy permits overdraft. Entries of other apps
of the organization are not listed, so consecutive `balanceAfter` values
can differ by more than `amountDelta`.

expiresAt.description: `promo_credit` only: when the unused part of these promotional credits expires.

OtpCreditLedgerItem.description: Audit-safe wallet mutation projection for the authenticated tenant.

OtpCreditLedgerEntryType.description:
Wallet ledger entry type: `credit` (purchased top-up), `debit` (issue
charge), `refund` (issue charge returned), `clawback` (purchased credits
removed, e.g. after a credit-pack refund), `promo_credit` (free promotional
credits granted, with `expiresAt`), `promo_expire` (unused promotional
credits expired) or `promo_revoke` (unused promotional credits taken back).
New types may be added; treat unknown values as other adjustments.

walletId.description: `org:<organizationId>` for the organization wallet; `app:<appId>` for a legacy per-app wallet.

walletScope.description: `organization` when the balance is shared by every app of the organization.

balance.description:
Current total balance as a credit quantity (not money): purchased plus
promotional credits.

promoBalance.description:
Unused, unexpired promotional (free) credits included in `balance`.
Purchased credits are roughly `balance - promoBalance`. Computed from the
promotional lot summary, which can lag recent sends by about 10 minutes;
never more than `balance`. Always `0` for a legacy per-app wallet.

promoNextExpiry.description: The promotional credits that expire first, or `null` when there are none.

OtpBalanceOutput.description:
Credit wallet balance visible to the authenticated app. For an app of an
organization this is the organization wallet shared by all of its apps.

WalletScope.description:
`organization`: the organization credit wallet (`org:<organizationId>`) shared
by every app of the organization. `app`: the legacy per-app wallet, which is
being retired.

amount.description: How many credits expire then (at most `promoBalance`).

PromoExpiry.description: The earliest-expiring promotional credits of a wallet.

ListTemplatesOutput.description: All templates available to the authenticated app.

isDefault.description: `true` for the template used when `templateId` is omitted.

providerTemplateCode.description: Pre-registered provider (AlimTalk) template code; empty when the template has no AlimTalk.

channelSupport.description: Channels this template can be sent on.

body.description: Message body; `#{code}` is replaced with the OTP and other `#{variable}` placeholders with `templateVariables`.

channelSupport.description: Channels this template can be sent on.

body.description: Message body; `#{code}` is replaced with the OTP and other `#{variable}` placeholders with `templateVariables`.

variables.description: Variables accepted in `templateVariables` when issuing with this template.

required.description: Variable names that must be supplied.

TemplateVariableSchema.description: JSON-schema-like variable definition. `code` is always filled in by the server and must not be sent in `templateVariables`.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match, if constrained.

XRequestId.description: Opaque request correlation id, present on every response (success and error). Echoes the request `X-Request-Id` when it matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$`; otherwise a generated UUID. Quote it when contacting support.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds (rounded up, at least 1) until a retry can be admitted; the same wait as `data.retryAfterMs`. Exposed to allowed browser origins via CORS.

RetryAfterUnavailable.description: Seconds until a retry can be admitted. Set only when the rate limiter is unavailable and the request failed closed (`pk_` keys, or a rejected limiter input); absent for other 503 causes. Exposed to allowed browser origins via CORS.

post.summary: Issue OTP and queue outbound delivery
post.description:
Generates a 6-digit OTP, applies quota admission, records the issue, and queues delivery by KakaoTalk AlimTalk with an automatic SMS fallback when AlimTalk delivery fails. The plaintext code is never returned; only `issueId`, expiry, and attempt metadata are.

**Idempotency.** An idempotency key is required, either in the `Idempotency-Key` header or the body `idempotencyKey` field (both must match when both are sent). A retry with the same key and payload returns the original response without re-sending or re-debiting. When the outcome of the first attempt is unknown (timeout, 503), retry only with the same key.

**Replacement.** Issuing again for the same phone number and purpose (with a new key) marks the previous `issued` OTP as `replaced`. Phone numbers are compared in canonical form: a Korean mobile number is the same number in any spelling (`010-1234-5678`, `01012345678`, `+82 10 1234 5678`); other numbers are compared by their digits only (`+1 415-555-0100` = `14155550100`).

**WebOTP.** With `webOtp` the SMS fallback ends with `@<host> #<code>` so Android Chrome can auto-fill the code on that origin when it arrives by SMS. `true` binds the request `Origin` header (any key type that sends one); `{ origin }` names it (server `sk_` calls; a `pk_` key may only name its own `Origin`). The origin must be `https` without a path or port and must be listed in the key's `allowedOrigins`; a key without `allowedOrigins` cannot use WebOTP (`http://localhost` and unlisted origins are accepted only in local development). It uses a compact template and never changes the message type or price: when the compact SMS with the line would exceed 90 bytes (line breaks counted as 2), the normal text is sent without it. The KakaoTalk message never carries the line, so the response `webOtp` reports `fallback_only` (or `skipped` with a `reason`).

**Billing.** Credit is reserved at admission and finalized asynchronously after send processing; the response does not include balance or debit amounts. The charged amount is decided server-side per delivery channel (the SMS fallback is included in the AlimTalk price); the deprecated `cost` field is ignored for billing for every key type. Quota rejection returns 402 with `data.code`.

Accepts `pk_` public keys (browser, `Origin` must exactly match an allowed origin) or `sk_` secret keys.

**Rate limits.** The key's `perKey`, `perIp` and `perPhone` rules are enforced after validation. For `pk_` keys the platform default covers `perKey`/`perIp` the key does not set and its `perPhone` default always applies; `perKey`/`perIp` never exceed the platform ceiling. An exceeded rule returns 429 with `Retry-After` and `data.retryAfterMs`.

200.description: OTP issued (or an idempotent replay of an earlier issue with the same key).

issueId.description: Identifier of the issued OTP; pass it to `POST /v1/verify`.

expiresAt.description: When the OTP stops being verifiable (RFC 3339).

attemptsRemaining.description: Verification attempts left for this issue.

webOtp.description: Present only when the request set `webOtp`.

schema.description: Result of `POST /v1/issue`. The OTP code itself is never returned.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: invalid payload, missing/blank idempotency key, header/body key mismatch, a `phoneNumber` without digits, unknown template or template variables, a `channel` the template does not support, `expiresInSec`/`maxAttempts`/`cost` out of range (`cost` is still range-checked though it no longer affects billing), or a `webOtp` origin the key may not bind (not listed in the key `allowedOrigins` or the key has none, not https, has a path or a port, not a domain, missing request `Origin` for `true`, or a `pk_` origin other than the request `Origin`).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: the `Authorization: Bearer` credential is missing, malformed, inactive, or rejected by introspection.

402.description: PAYMENT_REQUIRED: quota admission rejected the issue. `data.code` is `INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT` or `OVERDRAFT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (top up the wallet before retrying), or `TRIAL_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: a wallet that has never bought credits reached its daily free-trial send limit, which resets at `data.resetAt` (next 00:00 Asia/Seoul) or as soon as credits are purchased.

code.description:
Why quota admission rejected the issue. `TRIAL_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: a
wallet that has never bought credits reached its daily send limit (free
trial); it lifts at `resetAt` or as soon as credits are purchased.

resetAt.description:
With `TRIAL_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: when the daily trial limit resets (the
next 00:00 Asia/Seoul, RFC 3339).

data.description: Error data of a 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED response from `POST /v1/issue`.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the credential lacks `otp:issue` (or an accepted alias), or a `pk_` public key was sent without an `Origin` header / with an `Origin` that is not an exact match for one of the key's allowedOrigins.

409.description: CONFLICT: the idempotency key was already used with a different payload, or the replayed issue has since been replaced by a newer issue.

429.description: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: the API key exceeded a rate limit. `data.limit` names the rule (`perKey`, `perIp` or `perPhone`) and `data.policy` whether it came from the key's own policy (`key`) or a platform limit (`platform`: the default for `pk_` keys or the platform ceiling). Wait `data.retryAfterMs` milliseconds (the `Retry-After` header carries the same wait in seconds) before retrying; reuse the same idempotency key. Rejected requests do not consume the limit.

limit.description:
Rule that rejected the request: `perKey` (all requests of the key for this
operation), `perIp` (per client IP, issue only) or `perPhone` (per
recipient number, issue only).

policy.description:
`key`: the rate-limit policy configured on the API key. `platform`: a
platform limit, either the default for the key type (currently `pk_`
public keys) or the platform ceiling a key rule was capped at.

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until a retry can be admitted.

data.description:
Error data of a 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS response from `POST /v1/issue` or
`POST /v1/verify`. The `Retry-After` response header carries the same wait
in whole seconds (rounded up).

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: unexpected server failure. Undefined errors (`defined: false`) use the same envelope.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: introspection or a downstream dependency is unavailable, the rate limiter is unavailable for a `pk_` key (fail-closed, `Retry-After` set), or an earlier attempt with this idempotency key is still being resolved. Retry later with the same key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key that makes `POST /issue` safe to retry. Required for every issue request unless the body `idempotencyKey` is provided; if both are sent they must match. After trimming, the key must be 1-128 visible ASCII characters (no spaces). Retrying with the same key and payload replays the original result without a second send or debit; reusing a key with a different payload returns 409 CONFLICT. If the first attempt timed out or returned 503, retry with the same key — never mint a new key, because the provider outcome may be ambiguous and a new key can cause a duplicate message.

post.description:
Checks a 6-digit `code` against `issueId` with one-time semantics. On success the issue transitions to `verified` and cannot be verified again. A wrong code consumes one attempt. Verification failures are returned as 200 with `verified: false` and a `reasonCode` (`MISMATCH`, `MAX_ATTEMPTS`, `EXPIRED`, `ALREADY_VERIFIED`, `REPLACED`, `NOT_FOUND`), not as HTTP errors.

Accepts `pk_` public keys (browser, `Origin` must exactly match an allowed origin) or `sk_` secret keys.

**Rate limits.** The key's `perKey` rule (for `pk_` keys the platform default when the key sets none), capped at the platform ceiling, is enforced after validation; an exceeded rule returns 429 with `Retry-After` and `data.retryAfterMs`.

code.description: The 6-digit numeric code the end user received.

verified.description: `true` only when the code matched an active, unexpired issue.

attemptsRemaining.description: Verification attempts left after this call.

verifiedAt.description: When the issue was verified (RFC 3339), if it has been.

schema.description:
Result of `POST /v1/verify`. A failed verification is still a 200 response
with `verified: false` and a `reasonCode`.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: invalid payload, blank `issueId`, or `code` is not a 6-digit numeric string.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: the `Authorization: Bearer` credential is missing, malformed, inactive, or rejected by introspection.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the credential lacks `otp:verify` (or an accepted alias), or a `pk_` public key was sent without an `Origin` header / with an `Origin` that is not an exact match for one of the key's allowedOrigins.

409.description: CONFLICT: the request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

429.description: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: the API key exceeded a rate limit. `data.limit` names the rule (`perKey`) and `data.policy` whether it came from the key's own policy (`key`) or a platform limit (`platform`: the default for `pk_` keys or the platform ceiling). Wait `data.retryAfterMs` milliseconds (the `Retry-After` header carries the same wait in seconds) before retrying; rejected requests do not consume the limit or a verification attempt.

limit.description:
Rule that rejected the request: `perKey` (all requests of the key for this
operation), `perIp` (per client IP, issue only) or `perPhone` (per
recipient number, issue only).

policy.description:
`key`: the rate-limit policy configured on the API key. `platform`: a
platform limit, either the default for the key type (currently `pk_`
public keys) or the platform ceiling a key rule was capped at.

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until a retry can be admitted.

data.description:
Error data of a 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS response from `POST /v1/issue` or
`POST /v1/verify`. The `Retry-After` response header carries the same wait
in whole seconds (rounded up).

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: unexpected server failure. Undefined errors (`defined: false`) use the same envelope.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: introspection or a downstream dependency is unavailable, or the rate limiter is unavailable for a `pk_` key (fail-closed, `Retry-After` set). Retry with backoff.

get.description:
Returns verification state, delivery state, and the computed `overallStatus` for one issue owned by the authenticated app. `overallStatus` equals `verificationStatus` unless it is `issued`; while `issued` it is derived from `deliveryStatus` (`delivered` -> `delivered`, `failed` -> `delivery_failed`, `queued`/`sent` -> `in_progress`, `unknown` -> `pending_lookup`).

Immediately after `POST /issue` the issue row may still be persisting asynchronously; for up to 60 seconds such an issue is reported as `pending_lookup` instead of 404. The phone number is never returned.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.

messageId.description: Identifier of the outbound message used for delivery tracking.

overallStatus.description:
`verificationStatus` unless it is `issued`; otherwise derived from
`deliveryStatus` for user-facing display.

providerOutcomeAmbiguous.description:
`true` when the provider outcome of the send is unknown (for example a
provider timeout). Such sends are never retried automatically.

schema.description: Status of a single issue. The phone number is never included.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: the `Authorization: Bearer` credential is missing, malformed, inactive, or rejected by introspection.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the credential lacks `otp:status` (or an accepted alias), or a `pk_` public key was used. Public keys are limited to issue/verify.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no issue with this `issueId` exists for the authenticated app (issues of other apps are indistinguishable from missing ones).

409.description: CONFLICT: the request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: unexpected server failure. Undefined errors (`defined: false`) use the same envelope.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: credential introspection or a downstream dependency is temporarily unavailable. Retry with backoff.

get.summary: List OTP issues for the authenticated app
get.description:
Returns a PII-free dashboard projection of OTP issues. The tenant is always derived from the bearer credential. Phone numbers, OTP material, provider payloads, idempotency keys, and free-form metadata are never included.

Results are ordered newest first (`createdAt` descending, ties broken by id) and keyset-paginated. Pass `limit` (1-100, default 50) and, for subsequent pages, the opaque `cursor` returned as `nextCursor`; `nextCursor` is omitted on the last page. Cursors are bound to the endpoint that issued them and must be sent unchanged. Keep the same filters while paging.

Optional `createdFrom`/`createdTo` (RFC 3339 date-time) select the half-open range `[createdFrom, createdTo)`; when both are given `createdFrom` must be earlier than `createdTo`. `verificationStatus` filters by effective status: `issued` matches only unexpired issues, and `expired` also includes `issued` rows whose expiry has passed.

`deliveryStatus` is read from the delivery tracker and falls back to `unknown` if the tracker is temporarily unavailable.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.

parameters.description: Page size: 1-100 items. Defaults to 50 when omitted.

get.summary: Get an OTP issue for the authenticated app
get.description:
Returns the same PII-free projection as `GET /issues` for a single issue, including billing status and attempt counters. Issue identifiers belonging to other apps are indistinguishable from missing records.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.

expiresAt.description: Undefined only for legacy records that predate persisted expiry timestamps.

verifiedAt.description: Present once the issue was verified.

get.summary: List wallet ledger entries visible to the authenticated app
get.description:
Returns an audit projection of mutations of the wallet the key spends from: for an organization wallet, its `credit` top-ups and `clawback`s plus only the authenticated app's per-issue `debit`s and `refund`s (`appId` attributes app-level entries). `amountDelta` is signed (debits are negative) and `balanceAfter` is the wallet balance after the entry. Internal billing references, external payment references, and initiator metadata are omitted; `issueId` is present only for issue-linked entries.

Results are ordered newest first (`createdAt` descending, ties broken by id) and keyset-paginated. Pass `limit` (1-100, default 50) and, for subsequent pages, the opaque `cursor` returned as `nextCursor`; `nextCursor` is omitted on the last page. Cursors are bound to the endpoint that issued them and must be sent unchanged. Keep the same filters while paging.

Optional `createdFrom`/`createdTo` (RFC 3339 date-time) select the half-open range `[createdFrom, createdTo)`; when both are given `createdFrom` must be earlier than `createdTo`. `entryType` filters by entry type.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.

get.description:
Returns the current balance of the credit wallet the authenticated app spends from: the organization wallet shared by every app of the organization (`walletScope: organization`), or a legacy per-app wallet (`walletScope: app`). `balance` is a credit quantity (not money) and `currency` is `CREDIT`. Reading the balance never affects OTP issue status.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.

walletId.description: `org:<organizationId>` for the organization wallet; `app:<appId>` for a legacy per-app wallet.

walletScope.description: `organization` when the balance is shared by every app of the organization.

balance.description:
Current total balance as a credit quantity (not money): purchased plus
promotional credits.

promoBalance.description:
Unused, unexpired promotional (free) credits included in `balance`.
Purchased credits are roughly `balance - promoBalance`. Computed from the
promotional lot summary, which can lag recent sends by about 10 minutes;
never more than `balance`. Always `0` for a legacy per-app wallet.

promoNextExpiry.description: The promotional credits that expire first, or `null` when there are none.

schema.description:
Credit wallet balance visible to the authenticated app. For an app of an
organization this is the organization wallet shared by all of its apps.

get.description:
Returns the whitelisted message templates that `POST /issue` accepts via `templateId`, plus the default template id used when `templateId` is omitted. The list is small and not paginated. Every template body contains the `#{code}` placeholder; new templates are registered operationally, not through the API.

Requires an `sk_` secret key; `pk_` public keys are rejected with 403.
